item.title: Show HN: Mindspark
item.summary: This could be the only mind map you would be looking for. MindSpark is an open-source mind-mapping app you actually own - no accounts, no paywalls, no feature gates, no usage limits. Self-host it in one command, run it free in the browser with every map saved to your own private GitHub repo, or add one small Cloudflare Worker to unlock real-time sharing and collaboration Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49435816 Points: 1 # Comments: 1
